hospital.vitalsLine: VITALS: None recorded — NO vitals were recorded TODAY for this patient. If ANY vital sign (blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, weight) was dictated anywhere in today's pre-round or encounter text below, report THOSE values in the note rather than writing 'not provided' or leaving the vitals blank. If none was, the vital-signs line reads "Vital signs: not dictated today"; never fill it from an earlier day.
hospital.labsLine: LABS (recorded today): None recorded — NO labs were recorded TODAY. If ANY laboratory value was dictated in today's pre-round or encounter text below, report THOSE values rather than writing 'not provided'.
hospital.earlierVitals: EARLIER VITALS — recorded on a PREVIOUS day, NOT today. Never report them as today's values or as exam findings; mention one only with its date (e.g. "HR 88 on Oct 4"), such as for a trend: BP 132/80 mmHg (Oct 14), HR 88 bpm (Oct 14), Temp 37.4 °C (Oct 14), SpO2 95% RA (Oct 14)
hospital.earlierLabs: EARLIER LABS — recorded on a PREVIOUS day, NOT today. Never report them as today's values; mention one only with its date (e.g. "Hgb 9.4 on Oct 4"), such as for a trend: Cr: 1.4 (↑ from 1.1) (Oct 14); K: 3.8 (Oct 14)
